note: EMACS' OWN CONDITIONS ARE THE SAME MECHANISM, which is what makes this a substrate item and not a library one. Emacs answers ((wrong-type-argument error) (arith-error error) (error) "Wrong type argument") -- every built-in condition is a plist a package can READ, and `error''s own conditions list is just (error). kg answers (nil nil nil "Wrong type argument"): it has the messages but not the condition lists, because its hierarchy is a fixed table in fe. `ellama.el:3607' reads `(get err-type \'error-conditions)' on conditions it did not define, and gets nil here.
